## On the dot

**Word Power 28 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Exactly on time or at the time mentioned.

### Usage

1. I'll meet you at 12 on the dot. Don't forget.
2. Breakfast is served at 8 on the dot.
3. The taxi showed up on the dot.

### Your turn

Use “on the dot” in a sentence of your own. The original lesson image also includes Hindi support and illustrations.
